entries.note: Disaster Declarations Summaries v2: one row per declared county/area (disasterNumber, state, fipsStateCode, fipsCountyCode, declarationDate, incidentType, declarationType DR | EM | FM, ...). entries.licence: SEC EDGAR data: US Government work, public domain; SEC fair-access policy (declared User-Agent, at most 10 requests per second). Queried live through Zetaris, never redistributed.
entries.note: One XBRL fact per filer for one tag and calendar period (CY2025Q1, CY2024Q1) under us-gaap Revenues, RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax, RegulatedAndUnregulatedOperatingRevenue. Facts: cik (integer: LPAD(CAST(cik AS STRING), 10, '0') is the key), entityName, loc ('US-XX': SUBSTR(loc, 4, 2) is the state), start, end, val (inferred double or bigint by period: CAST(val AS DOUBLE)), accn. Frames serve the most recently filed fact for the period.
entries.verified_how: Weather-or-Not registered and cached the six (tag, period) views on 2026-10-24; Crosswalk's CW_SEC copies are registered by lane Z

entries.licence: NOAA GHCN-Daily: CC0-1.0 / US Government work (Registry of Open Data on AWS, bucket noaa-ghcn-pds); attribution to NOAA NCEI requested.
entries.note: GHCN-Daily parquet partitioned by year and element (ID, DATE yyyymmdd, DATA_VALUE in tenths of a degree C, M_FLAG, Q_FLAG, S_FLAG, OBS_TIME). Years 2024 and 2025, elements TMAX and TMIN; isS3BucketPublic true, endpoint s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com, no credentials. Every read of a filestore table costs about 9 s per table per view level; the raw tables are never cached, the station-filtered views are. Days with a non-empty Q_FLAG on either element are dropped.
entries.verified_how: Weather-or-Not registered and cached the four year/element views on 2026-10-24 (pyarrow row counts matched); Crosswalk's CW_GHCN copies are registered by lane Z

entries.licence: NOAA GHCN-Daily: CC0-1.0 / US Government work (Registry of Open Data on AWS, bucket noaa-ghcn-pds); attribution to NOAA NCEI requested.
entries.note: Fixed-width station list: id columns 1-11, latitude 13-20, longitude 22-30, elevation 32-37, state 39-40, name 42-71 (GSN flag 73-75, HCN/CRN flag 77-79, WMO id 81-85). Registered as a one-column CSV with a delimiter that never occurs in the file (for example '|' or U+0001) and parsed with SUBSTR in a view: SUBSTR(line, 1, 11) AS id, SUBSTR(line, 39, 2) AS state, SUBSTR(line, 42, 30) AS name. Key: id vs seeds station_ids (identity); state vs states.code.
entries.verified_how: not yet verified in Zetaris (gate G2, lane Z); fallback is seeds/stations.json (56 stations with state, verified by Weather-or-Not on 2026-10-24)
